accepted.name: observations_core
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  id AS station_id,
  date AS obs_date,
  element AS element,
  value AS value,
  mflag AS measurement_flag,
  qflag AS quality_flag,
  sflag AS source_flag,
  time AS obs_time
FROM `bigquery-public-data.ghcn_d.ghcnd_1876`
accepted.description: Normalized projection of raw observation rows with typed columns and easily-joined station id/date/element. Use this as the canonical observations relation for downstream filters, joins, and aggregations. | Use for: Filter observations by station/date/element/flags; Aggregate values by day/month/year or station; Join observations to station metadata for mapping or grouping by state

accepted.name: stations_dim
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  id AS station_id,
  latitude AS latitude,
  longitude AS longitude,
  elevation AS elevation,
  state AS state_code,
  name AS station_name,
  gsn_flag AS gsn_flag,
  hcn_crn_flag AS hcn_crn_flag,
  wmoid AS wmoid,
  source_url AS source_url,
  etl_timestamp AS etl_timestamp
FROM `bigquery-public-data.ghcn_d.ghcnd_stations`
accepted.description: Clean station dimension projecting location and descriptive attributes. Use for joins to map station_id to latitude/longitude/elevation/state and station name. | Use for: Map observations to station locations; Filter or aggregate observations by state_code or geographic bounding box; Enrich aggregate results with station metadata

accepted.name: inventory_by_station_element
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  id AS station_id,
  element AS element,
  firstyear AS first_year,
  lastyear AS last_year,
  latitude AS latitude,
  longitude AS longitude,
  source_url AS source_url,
  etl_timestamp AS etl_timestamp
FROM `bigquery-public-data.ghcn_d.ghcnd_inventory`
accepted.description: Inventory of which elements are available at each station with first/last year. Use to restrict analyses to station-elements that report data across certain year ranges or to check coverage. | Use for: Select stations that report a given element during a year range; Estimate station coverage over time for specific elements

accepted.name: station_state_lookup
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  s.id AS station_id,
  s.latitude AS latitude,
  s.longitude AS longitude,
  s.elevation AS elevation,
  s.state AS state_code,
  st.name AS state_name,
  s.name AS station_name,
  s.gsn_flag AS gsn_flag,
  s.hcn_crn_flag AS hcn_crn_flag,
  s.wmoid AS wmoid,
  s.source_url AS source_url,
  s.etl_timestamp AS etl_timestamp
FROM `bigquery-public-data.ghcn_d.ghcnd_stations` s
LEFT JOIN `bigquery-public-data.ghcn_d.ghcnd_states` st
  ON s.state = st.code
accepted.description: Join stations to state names. Use this when grouping or filtering by human-readable state names. Preserves one row per station. | Use for: Aggregate observations by state name; List stations with state metadata for mapping and reporting

accepted.name: daily_observation_counts_by_station_element
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  id AS station_id,
  date AS obs_date,
  element AS element,
  COUNT(1) AS obs_count,
  COUNTIF(value IS NOT NULL) AS non_null_value_count,
  AVG(value) AS avg_value,
  MIN(value) AS min_value,
  MAX(value) AS max_value
FROM `bigquery-public-data.ghcn_d.ghcnd_1876`
GROUP BY station_id, obs_date, element
accepted.description: Daily counts and basic aggregates of observations per station + element + date. Useful as a pre-aggregation to compute coverage, average daily values, or identify missing days. | Use for: Compute daily coverage and summary stats per station/element; Detect days with missing or duplicate observations

accepted.name: station_element_recent_rank
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  id AS station_id,
  element AS element,
  date AS obs_date,
  value AS value,
  mflag AS measurement_flag,
  qflag AS quality_flag,
  ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY id, element ORDER BY date DESC, time DESC) AS obs_date_rank
FROM `bigquery-public-data.ghcn_d.ghcnd_1876`
accepted.description: Per station and element, rank observations by date descending so callers can easily select the most recent N observations per station-element by filtering rank <= N. | Use for: Get the most recent observation(s) per station-element; Compare latest reported values across stations for an element

accepted.name: monthly_stats_by_station_element
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  id AS station_id,
  element AS element,
  EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date) AS year,
  EXTRACT(MONTH FROM date) AS month,
  COUNT(1) AS obs_count,
  COUNTIF(value IS NOT NULL) AS non_null_value_count,
  AVG(value) AS avg_value,
  MIN(value) AS min_value,
  MAX(value) AS max_value
FROM `bigquery-public-data.ghcn_d.ghcnd_1876`
GROUP BY station_id, element, year, month
accepted.description: Monthly aggregated statistics (count, mean, min, max) per station and element. Useful for monthly trend analysis and as input to year-over-year comparisons. | Use for: Compute monthly climatologies per station/element; Detect monthly anomalies and trend analysis

accepted.name: station_location_grid
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  id AS station_id,
  latitude AS latitude,
  longitude AS longitude,
  elevation AS elevation,
  state AS state_code,
  name AS station_name
FROM `bigquery-public-data.ghcn_d.ghcnd_stations`
accepted.description: Station locations with latitude/longitude and basic attributes. Useful for spatial joins or filtering by geographic bounding boxes. One row per station. | Use for: Filter stations within geographic bounding boxes; Prepare station points for mapping or spatial clustering
